company.name: Star Micro Insurance Company Limited
company.about: Star Micro Insurance is a micro non-life insurer based in Janakpurdham and licensed by the Nepal Insurance Authority in 2080 BS (2023). It offers low-cost motor, property, burglary, accident and cargo cover to underserved households and small businesses.
highlights: About 1,44,000 policies issued and over NPR 4 crore in claims paid (company website)
NPR 260 million in premium in the first 10 months of FY 2025/26

policies.name: Motor Insurance (Third Party)
policies.summary: Legally required cover for injury or damage your vehicle causes to others.
features: Premium fixed by the NIA tariff
benefits: Third-party death and injury claims as per tariff
Third-party property damage up to the limit

pricing.note: Indicative third-party tariff, 150cc-250cc bike; check NIA tariff for your cc

bestFor: Anyone who needs the legal minimum vehicle cover

policies.name: Property Micro Insurance
policies.summary: Covers your home, shop or small business against fire, flood, earthquake, landslide and burglary.
benefits: Compensation for damage to the insured property
Cover for loss from fire and natural disasters

policies.name: Personal Accident Insurance
policies.summary: Pays a lump sum for accidental death, permanent disability or loss of income.
features: Covers death, disability and income loss
Claims via email or service points
bestFor: Low-income workers who rely on daily wages
